tree.heading: Federal Charter.—
tree.text: Daughters of Union Veterans of the Civil War 1861–1865 (in this chapter, the “corporation”), a nonprofit corporation incorporated in Ohio, is a federally chartered corporation.

tree.heading: Expiration of Charter.—
tree.text: If the corporation does not comply with any provision of this chapter, the charter granted by this chapter expires.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 50102(a)36:3701.Dec. 9, 1985, Pub. L. 99–172, §§ 1, 16, 99 Stat. 1020, 1023. 50102(b)36:3715. In subsection (a), the words “incorporated in Ohio” are substituted for “organized under the laws of the State of Ohio” for consistency in the revised title and to eliminate unnecessary words.
